# Rollendaten

> What a role may read (RB-5), on the Rollen page of the Platform's console - its folders and documents at the Core, the dry run before each change, four eyes, adopting an existing Core group, moving direct group grants into roles.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-ROLE-DATA` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_role_data.py`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/_role_data.html`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ROLE-DATA/R-1` | The part «Darf lesen» shows the folder rules and own-rights documents naming the role's Core group, read from the Core on every page (no copy kept), with «wirkt mit «Ein»» until the tenant is brokered; adds and removes a source, folder or document after a dry run of who gains and loses sight, through acl_change, planned again when carried out and only by an administrator; lets a role adopt an existing Core group (FU-45) and moves direct group grants into roles without changing anybody's sight (FU-41). | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_role_data.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/_role_data.html` |

### Not responsible for

- The Rollen page, its other parts and routes (L2-PLATFORM-ROLES), which draws this card's part and answers its routes.
- The four-eyes path (run_guarded, the Freigaben page; L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN) and execute_acl_change (L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS), which hands this card its two actions.
- Whether the data hide anything; the Core decides, for the Platform's claims only under brokered (CR-R1 to CR-R3).

### Terms

- dry run (Probelauf: what a change would do and who would gain or lose sight under «Ein»; it writes nothing)
